frontmatter.title: Running Underworld in a Browser: Any Repository, Any Version
frontmatter.description: One link opens Underworld in a browser, with any public repository pulled in beside it and any released version underneath. Nothing is installed, and nothing has to be added to the repository being launched. We use it for teaching, for workshops, and for anyone who would rather run the model from a paper than read about it.

Forty minutes is a busy researcher’s attention span and about the time it takes to

the remainder on the actual tasks. Departmental lab machines fix this until the

home.
